sources.title: Independent softmax numeric and ordering derivation
sources.details: For [2s,s,0], p_max=exp(2s)/(exp(2s)+exp(s)+1)=1/(1+exp(-s)+exp(-2s)); candidate count=3, per-row sum=1. Reference s=1: 0.6652409557748218; s=10: 0.999954600070331. Float32 errors <1e-7; rounding to 4 decimal places gives 0.6652 and 1.0. For positive T, z_i/T > z_j/T iff z_i > z_j; exp is increasing and a shared positive denominator preserves this ordering. Labels do not occur in normalization.
